source.text: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις πληθυνόντων τῶν μαθητῶν ἐγένετο γογγυσμὸς τῶν Ἑλληνιστῶν πρὸς τοὺς Ἑβραίους ὅτι παρεθεωροῦντο ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ τῇ καθημερινῇ αἱ χῆραι αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: In now the days these, multiplying the disciples, there arose a grumbling of the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because were being overlooked in the serving the daily the widows of them.

en.L: Now in these days, as the disciples were multiplying, there arose a grumbling of the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily serving.
en.B: In those days, while the number of disciples kept growing, the Greek-speaking believers began to grumble against those who spoke Hebrew. Their widows, they said, were being passed over when food was given out each day.
en.R: During this time more and more people became followers of Jesus. Some of them spoke Greek, and others spoke the language of the Jews in Judea. The Greek speakers began to complain about the others. Every day food was handed out to widows, but the Greek-speaking widows were being left out.

fr.L: Or en ces jours-là, comme les disciples se multipliaient, il s’éleva un murmure des Hellénistes contre les Hébreux, parce que leurs veuves étaient négligées dans le service quotidien.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, comme le nombre des disciples ne cessait de croître, les croyants de langue grecque se mirent à murmurer contre ceux de langue hébraïque : leurs veuves, disaient-ils, étaient oubliées lors de la distribution quotidienne de nourriture.
fr.R: À cette époque, de plus en plus de gens sont devenus disciples de Jésus. Certains parlaient grec, et d’autres parlaient la langue des Juifs de Judée. Ceux qui parlaient grec ont commencé à se plaindre des autres. Chaque jour, on distribuait de la nourriture aux veuves, mais les veuves qui parlaient grec étaient oubliées.

sw.L: Basi katika siku hizi, wanafunzi walipokuwa wakiongezeka, palitokea manung'uniko ya Wahelenisti dhidi ya Waebrania, kwa sababu wajane wao walikuwa wakisahauliwa katika huduma ya kila siku.
sw.B: Katika siku hizo, idadi ya wanafunzi ilipokuwa ikiongezeka, waumini Wayahudi waliozungumza Kigiriki walianza kuwanung'unikia wale waliozungumza Kiebrania. Walisema kwamba wajane wao walikuwa wakisahauliwa wakati chakula kilipogawiwa kila siku.
sw.R: Wakati huo watu wengi zaidi na zaidi wakawa wanafunzi wa Yesu. Baadhi yao walizungumza Kigiriki, na wengine walizungumza lugha ya Wayahudi wa Uyahudi. Wale waliozungumza Kigiriki wakaanza kuwalalamikia wenzao. Kila siku wajane waligawiwa chakula, lakini wajane waliozungumza Kigiriki walikuwa wakisahauliwa.

es.L: Y en estos días, al multiplicarse los discípulos, se produjo una murmuración de los helenistas contra los hebreos, porque sus viudas eran desatendidas en el servicio diario.
es.B: En aquellos días, mientras el número de los discípulos seguía creciendo, los creyentes de habla griega comenzaron a murmurar contra los de habla hebrea. Decían que sus viudas eran pasadas por alto en el reparto diario de alimentos.
es.R: En ese tiempo, cada vez más personas se hacían discípulos de Jesús. Algunos de ellos hablaban griego, y otros hablaban el idioma de los judíos de Judea. Los que hablaban griego comenzaron a quejarse de los otros. Cada día se repartía comida a las viudas, pero a las viudas que hablaban griego las estaban dejando fuera.

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy, khi số môn đồ gia tăng, những người nói tiếng Hy Lạp lằm bằm chống lại những người nói tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ, vì các bà góa của họ bị bỏ sót trong việc phân phát hằng ngày.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, khi số môn đồ ngày càng đông, những tín hữu nói tiếng Hy Lạp bắt đầu phàn nàn về những người nói tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ. Họ nói rằng các bà góa của họ bị bỏ sót khi thức ăn được phân phát hằng ngày.
vi.R: Trong thời gian ấy, càng ngày càng có nhiều người trở thành môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu. Một số người nói tiếng Hy Lạp, còn những người khác nói tiếng của người Do Thái ở Giu-đê. Những người nói tiếng Hy Lạp bắt đầu phàn nàn về những người kia. Mỗi ngày thức ăn được phát cho các bà góa, nhưng các bà góa nói tiếng Hy Lạp lại bị bỏ sót.

ko.L: 그런데 이 무렵 제자들이 늘어나자, 헬라파 사람들이 히브리파 사람들에게 불평하는 일이 생겼다. 날마다 나누어 주는 일에서 그들의 과부들이 빠지고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 제자들의 수가 계속 늘어나자, 그리스 말을 하는 신자들이 히브리 말을 하는 신자들에게 불평하기 시작했다. 날마다 음식을 나누어 줄 때에 자기들의 과부들이 빠지곤 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그 무렵 예수의 제자가 되는 사람들이 점점 많아졌다. 그들 가운데에는 그리스 말을 하는 사람들도 있었고, 유대 땅의 유대인들이 쓰는 말을 하는 사람들도 있었다. 그리스 말을 하는 사람들이 다른 사람들에게 불평하기 시작했다. 날마다 과부들에게 음식을 나누어 주었는데, 그리스 말을 하는 과부들은 자꾸 빠졌기 때문이다.

pt.L: Ora, naqueles dias, multiplicando-se os discípulos, surgiu uma murmuração dos helenistas contra os hebreus, porque as viúvas deles estavam sendo esquecidas no serviço diário.
pt.B: Naqueles dias, enquanto o número dos discípulos crescia, os que falavam grego começaram a reclamar contra os que falavam hebraico. Diziam que as suas viúvas estavam sendo deixadas de lado na distribuição diária de comida.
pt.R: Nessa época, cada vez mais pessoas se tornavam seguidoras de Jesus. Algumas delas falavam grego, e outras falavam a língua dos judeus da Judeia. Os que falavam grego começaram a reclamar dos outros. Todos os dias era distribuída comida às viúvas, mas as viúvas que falavam grego estavam ficando sem a sua parte.

am.L: በእነዚህም ቀናት ደቀ መዛሙርት እየበዙ ሳሉ የግሪክኛ ተናጋሪዎቹ ማጉረምረም በዕብራውያኑ ላይ ተነሣ፤ መበለቶቻቸው በዕለት ተዕለቱ አገልግሎት ቸል ይባሉ ነበርና።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ የደቀ መዛሙርት ቁጥር እየጨመረ ሲሄድ፣ ግሪክኛ የሚናገሩት አማኞች ዕብራይስጥ በሚናገሩት ላይ ማጉረምረም ጀመሩ። በየዕለቱ ምግብ ሲታደል መበለቶቻቸው ቸል እንደሚባሉ ይናገሩ ነበር።
am.R: በዚህ ጊዜ የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዛሙርት የሆኑ ሰዎች ቁጥር እየበዛ ሄደ። ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ግሪክኛ ይናገሩ ነበር፤ ሌሎቹ ደግሞ በይሁዳ የሚኖሩ አይሁድ የሚናገሩትን ቋንቋ ይናገሩ ነበር። ግሪክኛ የሚናገሩት በሌሎቹ ላይ ማማረር ጀመሩ። በየቀኑ ለመበለቶች ምግብ ይታደል ነበር፤ ግሪክኛ የሚናገሩት መበለቶች ግን ይዘለሉ ነበር።

decisions.choice: Hellenists and Hebrews: two groups of Jewish believers, set apart mainly by language
decisions.reason: Both groups were Jews; the first Gentile believers come later (10:1-48, 11:20). The names point most clearly to language: the Hellenists spoke Greek, and many had come to Jerusalem from Jewish communities abroad (2:5-11, 6:9); the Hebrews spoke Hebrew or Aramaic, the language of the Jews of the land (21:40, 22:2). Whatever else divided them, the text says only that the complaint ran along this line.

decisions.choice: the daily serving: a share of food given each day to widows in need
decisions.reason: The believers shared what they had with anyone in need (2:44-45, 4:34-35). Widows often had no one to provide for them, and the law told Israel to care for them (Deuteronomy 14:29; 24:19-21). Serving at tables in 6:2 shows that food was being given out.

decisions.choice: serving: the work of serving, here the handing out of food
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the apostles' "service of the word" in 6:4, and its verb for serving at tables in 6:2. Luke sets the two kinds of service side by side.

decisions.choice: disciples: the believers in Jesus
decisions.reason: This is the first time Acts calls the whole community "disciples", learners who follow a teacher; the word is used of all believers from here on (6:7, 9:1, 11:26).

decisions.choice: were being overlooked: passed over again and again
decisions.reason: The verb is in the imperfect, for something that kept happening. It does not say whether the neglect was deliberate.

decisions.choice: the Greek-speaking believers; those who spoke Hebrew
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the names mean, as the meaning note explains; Literal keeps the names.

decisions.choice: food was given out each day
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what was being served, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R), with the imperfect for background
decisions.reason: As in Acts 4 and 5 (style guide §3, §9): the passé simple is the tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé. Speech keeps the tenses of speech. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: les Hellénistes, les Hébreux (L); les croyants de langue grecque, ceux de langue hébraïque (B)
alternatives: les Juifs de langue grecque at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two names, capitalised as names of groups; "les Grecs" would wrongly suggest non-Jews (m1). Balanced and Readable say what the names mean, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Wahelenisti, Waebrania (L); waumini Wayahudi waliozungumza Kigiriki, wale waliozungumza Kiebrania (B); described by their languages (R)
decisions.reason: Two groups of Jewish believers, set apart mainly by language (meaning decision on Hellenists and Hebrews). As in Acts 9:29, Literal keeps the names; "Wayunani" or "Wagiriki" would suggest Greeks who were not Jews, so Balanced and Readable describe them.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi wa Yesu (R)
alternatives: wafuasi wa Yesu, as the English Readable "followers"
decisions.reason: "Wanafunzi" is kept at every level through the New Testament, also where the English Readable says "followers"; Readable adds "wa Yesu". The same in 6:2 and 6:7.

decisions.choice: discípulos at every level
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: "discípulos" at every level, Readable included, where the English Readable says "followers".

decisions.choice: helenistas, hebreos (L); los creyentes de habla griega, los de habla hebrea (B)
decisions.reason: Two groups of Jewish believers set apart mainly by language (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Greek names, as in 11:20.

decisions.choice: "những người nói tiếng Hy Lạp" and "những người nói tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ" for the Hellenists and the Hebrews
decisions.reason: Both groups are Jewish believers, set apart mainly by language (meaning decision); naming them by their language keeps them from being read as Greeks and Jews.

decisions.choice: "môn đồ" for the disciples at every level (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "môn đồ" at every level; in Acts the word means all believers in Jesus (meaning decision), and Readable says "môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu" where that helps.

decisions.choice: "헬라파 사람들", "히브리파 사람들" (L); "그리스 말을 하는 신자들", "히브리 말을 하는 신자들" (B); described at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hellenists and the Hebrews were two groups of Jewish believers, set apart mainly by language (meaning decision). Literal keeps the Greek's two names as group names; Balanced and Readable say what set them apart, as the English does. "그리스" is the style guide's word for Greek.

decisions.choice: "제자들" at every level for mathētai, through Acts; "나누어 주는 일" for diakonia
decisions.reason: Disciples are the believers in Jesus (meaning decision). As in the Korean Gospels, the word stays "제자" at every level, even where the English Readable says "followers", so that it links to the disciples of the Gospels.

decisions.choice: os que falavam grego; os que falavam hebraico
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced and Readable say what the names mean (m1); "judeus gregos" would wrongly suggest they were not Jews by birth or not from Judea's people. Literal keeps the names "helenistas" and "hebreus".

decisions.choice: ግሪክኛ ተናጋሪዎቹ ... ዕብራውያኑ (L); ግሪክኛ የሚናገሩት ... ዕብራይስጥ የሚናገሩት (B, R)
alternatives: ሄሌናውያን (a transliteration of the Greek name)
decisions.reason: The Hellenists were Jewish believers whose language was Greek (m1); a transliterated name would mean nothing to an Amharic reader, so every level says who they were by their language. Literal keeps ዕብራውያን, 'Hebrews', as the Greek's name for the other group; Balanced and Readable name them by their language too.

decisions.choice: ደቀ መዛሙርት at Readable too
decisions.reason: As in the Gospels, ደቀ መዛሙርት is the settled word for the disciples at every level, where the English Readable says 'followers'; Readable adds 'of Jesus' to say whose disciples they are.

source.text: προσκαλεσάμενοι δὲ οἱ δώδεκα τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν εἶπαν· Οὐκ ἀρεστόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς καταλείψαντας τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ διακονεῖν τραπέζαις·

records.literal_gloss: Having called together then the Twelve the multitude of the disciples said, Not pleasing it is [for] us having left the word of the God to serve tables.

en.L: And the Twelve, having called together the multitude of the disciples, said, "It is not pleasing [for] us, having left the word of God, to serve tables.
en.B: So the Twelve called the whole company of the disciples together and said, "It is not fitting for us to leave aside the word of God in order to serve at tables.
en.R: So the twelve apostles called all the followers of Jesus together. They said, "We should not stop teaching God's message so that we can hand out food.

fr.L: Et les Douze, ayant convoqué la multitude des disciples, dirent : « Il ne nous convient pas de délaisser la parole de Dieu pour servir aux tables.
fr.B: Les Douze réunirent donc l’ensemble des disciples et leur dirent : « Il ne serait pas juste que nous laissions de côté la parole de Dieu pour faire le service des tables.
fr.R: Alors les douze apôtres ont réuni tous les disciples de Jésus. Ils leur ont dit : « Nous ne devons pas arrêter d’enseigner le message de Dieu pour distribuer de la nourriture.

sw.L: Basi wale Kumi na Wawili, wakiisha kuuita umati wa wanafunzi, wakasema, "Haitupendezi sisi kuliacha neno la Mungu ili kuhudumu mezani.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo wale Kumi na Wawili waliwaita pamoja wanafunzi wote, wakasema, "Haifai sisi tuache neno la Mungu ili tuhudumu mezani.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mitume kumi na wawili wakawaita pamoja wanafunzi wote wa Yesu. Wakasema, "Haifai sisi tuache kufundisha ujumbe wa Mungu ili tugawe chakula.

es.L: Y los Doce, habiendo convocado a la multitud de los discípulos, dijeron: «No es conveniente que nosotros, dejando la palabra de Dios, sirvamos a las mesas.
es.B: Entonces los Doce reunieron a todos los discípulos y les dijeron: «No está bien que nosotros dejemos de lado la palabra de Dios para servir las mesas.
es.R: Así que los doce apóstoles reunieron a todos los discípulos y les dijeron: «No debemos dejar de enseñar el mensaje de Dios para repartir comida.

vi.L: Bấy giờ nhóm Mười Hai gọi toàn thể môn đồ lại và nói: "Chúng tôi bỏ lời Đức Chúa Trời để lo việc bàn ăn thì không phải lẽ.
vi.B: Vậy nhóm Mười Hai triệu tập toàn thể môn đồ lại và nói: "Chúng tôi không nên bỏ việc rao giảng lời Đức Chúa Trời để lo phục vụ bàn ăn.
vi.R: Vì vậy mười hai sứ đồ gọi tất cả các môn đồ lại. Họ nói: "Chúng tôi không nên ngừng dạy sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời để đi phát thức ăn.

ko.L: 그러자 열두 [사도]가 제자들의 온 무리를 불러 모으고 말했다. "우리가 하나님의 말씀을 제쳐 두고 식탁을 섬기는 것은 마땅하지 않습니다.
ko.B: 그래서 열두 사도가 제자들을 모두 불러 모아 놓고 말했다. "우리가 하나님의 말씀을 전하는 일을 제쳐 두고 음식을 나누어 주는 일에 매달리는 것은 옳지 않습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 열두 사도가 모든 제자를 불러 모았다. 그리고 말했다. "우리가 음식을 나누어 주느라고 하나님의 말씀을 가르치는 일을 그만두어서는 안 됩니다.

pt.L: E os Doze, convocando a multidão dos discípulos, disseram: "Não é agradável [que] nós, deixando a palavra de Deus, sirvamos às mesas.
pt.B: Então os Doze reuniram todo o grupo dos discípulos e disseram: "Não é certo que nós deixemos de lado a palavra de Deus para servir às mesas.
pt.R: Então os Doze reuniram todos os seguidores de Jesus e disseram: "Nós não devemos parar de ensinar a mensagem de Deus para distribuir comida.

am.L: አሥራ ሁለቱም የደቀ መዛሙርቱን ብዛት ጠርተው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «እኛ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ትተን ማዕድ ማገልገላችን ደስ የሚያሰኝ አይደለም፤
am.B: ስለዚህ አሥራ ሁለቱ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ሁሉ በአንድነት ጠርተው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ወደ ጎን ትተን ማዕድ ለማገልገል መሰማራታችን ተገቢ አይደለም።
am.R: ስለዚህ አሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት የኢየሱስን ደቀ መዛሙርት ሁሉ በአንድነት ጠሩ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ምግብ ለማደል ብለን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ማስተማር ማቆም የለብንም።

decisions.choice: the Twelve: the apostles, with Matthias in Judas's place
decisions.reason: Luke calls the apostles "the Twelve" (Luke 6:13, 9:1). Their number was made whole again in 1:26.

decisions.choice: not pleasing: not right or fitting, not what God wants
decisions.reason: The word means acceptable or pleasing. The apostles do not look down on serving food; they say it is not their part to leave the word for it (6:4).

decisions.choice: serve tables: hand out the food for the daily share
alternatives: keep money tables, as bankers did
decisions.reason: "Tables" here goes with the daily serving of food in 6:1. The verb is the one from which the noun for "serving" comes, so the apostles set this serving beside the service of the word (6:4).

decisions.choice: the word of God: God's message about Jesus, which the apostles preached and taught
decisions.reason: As in 4:31, the word of God is the message the apostles were sent to speak (1:8).

decisions.choice: hand out food
decisions.reason: Readable says what serving tables meant here.

decisions.choice: teaching God's message
decisions.reason: Readable says what leaving the word would mean: no longer teaching it.

decisions.choice: les Douze (L, B); les douze apôtres (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's term (§9), capitalised as a title of the group; Readable names them as apostles, as the English does.

decisions.choice: wale Kumi na Wawili (L, B); mitume kumi na wawili (R)
decisions.reason: The Twelve as a group name, capitalised, as in the Gospels (meaning decision on the Twelve); Readable says who they were.

decisions.choice: "nhóm Mười Hai" (L, B); "mười hai sứ đồ" (R)
decisions.reason: The way the Vietnamese Luke 24:9 names "the Eleven".

decisions.choice: the Twelve speak to the whole community in 합쇼체, with "{{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분" (6:3)
decisions.reason: The apostles address the gathered believers as a public meeting, as Peter did in 1:16. "열두 [사도]" (L) supplies the noun Korean needs after the number, as in 2:14.

decisions.choice: os Doze (every level)
decisions.reason: "Os Doze", capitalised, is the name Luke uses for the apostles, as settled for the Gospels; Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "the twelve apostles", since Brazilian readers know the name and 1:26 has just made the number whole.

decisions.choice: ማዕድ ማገልገል (serve tables)
alternatives: ጠረጴዛ ማገልገል (serve the table, word for word)
ምግብ ማደል (hand out food, as at Readable)
decisions.reason: ማዕድ is the table as the place where a meal is laid, so 'serving the ማዕድ' says what the Greek idiom means, waiting on the daily meal, while keeping its picture; a word for the piece of furniture would not. Readable says plainly that the work is handing out food.

source.text: ἐπισκέψασθε δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἄνδρας ἐξ ὑμῶν μαρτυρουμένους ἑπτὰ πλήρεις πνεύματος καὶ σοφίας, οὓς καταστήσομεν ἐπὶ τῆς χρείας ταύτης·

records.literal_gloss: Select but, brothers, men from you being well spoken of seven, full of Spirit and of wisdom, whom we will appoint over the need this;

en.L: So select, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, seven men from among you who are well spoken of, full of [the] Spirit and of wisdom, whom we will appoint over this need.
en.B: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, look among yourselves for seven men of good reputation, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, and we will put them in charge of this need.
en.R: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, choose seven men from your group. Everyone must know that they are good men. They must be filled with the Holy Spirit and with wisdom. We will give them this job.

fr.L: Choisissez donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, sept hommes parmi vous, dont on rende un bon témoignage, pleins d’Esprit et de sagesse, que nous établirons sur cette tâche.
fr.B: Ainsi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, cherchez parmi vous sept hommes de bonne réputation, remplis de l’Esprit et de sagesse, et nous leur confierons ce besoin.
fr.R: Alors, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, choisissez sept hommes dans votre groupe. Tout le monde doit savoir que ce sont des hommes bons. Ils doivent être remplis de l’Esprit Saint et de sagesse. Nous leur donnerons ce travail.

sw.L: Basi, ndugu, chagueni miongoni mwenu wanaume saba wanaoshuhudiwa vyema, waliojaa Roho na hekima, ambao tutawaweka juu ya kazi hii.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, tafuteni miongoni mwenu wanaume saba wenye sifa njema, waliojaa Roho na hekima, nasi tutawapa jukumu la kushughulikia hitaji hili.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, chagueni wanaume saba kutoka katika kundi lenu. Kila mtu lazima ajue kwamba wao ni watu wema. Lazima wawe wamejaa Roho Mtakatifu na hekima. Tutawapa kazi hii.

es.L: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}}, pues, hermanos, de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a siete hombres de buen testimonio, llenos del Espíritu y de sabiduría, a quienes pondremos a cargo de esta necesidad.
es.B: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a siete hombres de buena reputación, llenos del Espíritu y de sabiduría, y los pondremos a cargo de esta tarea.
es.R: Así que, hermanos, {{plural_you:escojan|escoged}} a siete hombres de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Todos deben saber que son hombres buenos. Deben estar llenos del Espíritu Santo y de sabiduría. Nosotros les daremos este trabajo.

vi.L: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy chọn trong anh chị em bảy người nam có tiếng tốt, đầy dẫy Thánh Linh và sự khôn ngoan, để chúng tôi giao cho họ công việc cần thiết này.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy tìm trong anh chị em bảy người nam có tiếng tốt, đầy dẫy Thánh Linh và sự khôn ngoan, rồi chúng tôi sẽ giao cho họ lo việc này.
vi.R: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy chọn bảy người nam trong anh chị em. Mọi người phải biết họ là người tốt. Họ phải được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh và sự khôn ngoan. Chúng tôi sẽ giao công việc này cho họ.

ko.L: 그러니 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분 가운데서 칭찬을 받고 성령과 지혜가 충만한 사람 일곱을 고르십시오. 우리가 그들에게 이 일을 맡기겠습니다.
ko.B: 그러니 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분 가운데서 평판이 좋고 성령과 지혜가 가득한 남자 일곱을 찾아내십시오. 우리가 그들에게 이 일을 맡기겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 여러분 가운데서 남자 일곱 사람을 뽑으십시오. 모든 사람이 좋은 사람이라고 알고 있는 사람이어야 합니다. 그리고 성령과 지혜가 가득한 사람이어야 합니다. 우리가 그들에게 이 일을 맡기겠습니다.

pt.L: Escolham, pois, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, dentre vocês sete homens de bom testemunho, cheios do Espírito e de sabedoria, aos quais encarregaremos desta necessidade.
pt.B: Por isso, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, procurem entre vocês sete homens de boa reputação, cheios do Espírito e de sabedoria, e nós os encarregaremos dessa tarefa.
pt.R: Por isso, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, escolham sete homens do grupo de vocês. Todos precisam saber que eles são homens bons. Eles precisam estar cheios do Espírito Santo e de sabedoria. Nós vamos dar a eles esse trabalho.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ከእናንተ መካከል መልካም የተመሰከረላቸውን፣ መንፈስና ጥበብ የሞላባቸውን ሰባት ወንዶች ምረጡ፤ እነርሱንም በዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ እንሾማቸዋለን፤
am.B: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ከመካከላችሁ መልካም ስም ያላቸውን፣ በመንፈስና በጥበብ የተሞሉትን ሰባት ወንዶች ፈልጉ፤ እኛም ይህን ኃላፊነት እንሰጣቸዋለን።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ከመካከላችሁ ሰባት ወንዶችን ምረጡ። ሰዎች ሁሉ መልካም መሆናቸውን የሚያውቋቸው ይሁኑ። በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በጥበብ የተሞሉ ይሁኑ። ይህንም ሥራ እንሰጣቸዋለን።

decisions.choice: brothers: the whole community of disciples, men and women
decisions.reason: The apostles speak to "the multitude of the disciples" (6:2), and the choice was made by "the whole multitude" (6:5).

decisions.choice: men: the seven were to be men
decisions.reason: The word means adult males, not people in general, so it stays "men"; the address to the community before it takes in everyone.

decisions.choice: well spoken of: known and approved by others
decisions.reason: The verb means to be witnessed to; others vouch for them (compare 10:22, 16:2).

decisions.choice: Spirit: the Holy Spirit
alternatives: a human spirit, a spirited character
decisions.reason: Stephen is said in 6:5 to be full of the Holy Spirit, and the believers had been filled with the Spirit (2:4, 4:31).

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "full of the Spirit"
alternatives: some manuscripts read "full of the Holy Spirit"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts, followed by the King James Version, add "holy", perhaps from 6:5. The sense is the same. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: this need: the task of meeting the widows' need
decisions.reason: The word means a need, and so the work that meets it. The text gives the seven a task, not a title.

decisions.choice: brothers and sisters, with "brothers" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The address takes in the whole community, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: short sentences: everyone must know they are good men; filled with the Holy Spirit and with wisdom
alternatives: well spoken of, full of the Spirit and of wisdom
decisions.reason: Readable breaks up the description and names the Holy Spirit, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: ndugu, with no gender span; wanaume (men) for the seven
alternatives: a gender span like the English brothers and sisters / brothers
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, the whole community (meaning decision on brothers), so there is no second wording for the gender setting. The seven were to be men (meaning decision on men), so "wanaume" stays at every level.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 3:17: Spanish "hermanos" already takes in the women of the community (meaning decision on brothers), so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}
decisions.reason: The Twelve speak to the whole community, so every plural "you" is the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" for the address and "anh chị em" for "you", when the apostles speak to the believers
decisions.reason: The brothers are the whole community of disciples, men and women (meaning decision), and the apostles speak to them as the Vietnamese letters speak to their readers.

decisions.choice: "bảy người nam" for the seven men
decisions.reason: The seven were to be men (meaning decision), and the Greek says so with the word for males.

decisions.choice: "사람 일곱" (L), "남자 일곱" (B, R); "성령" for pneuma here
decisions.reason: The seven were to be men (meaning decision), which Balanced and Readable say; Literal keeps the order of the Greek. The Spirit is the Holy Spirit (meaning decision), so "성령" at every level.

decisions.choice: irmãos e irmãs, with "irmãos" as the alternative; "homens" plainly
decisions.reason: As the English: the address takes in the whole community (m1), while the seven are to be men (m2), so "homens" has no setting. Balanced says "tarefa" for the need, since the text gives the seven a task (m6).

decisions.choice: ሰባት ወንዶች (seven men)
decisions.reason: ሰዎች would leave open whether the seven were men or women; the Greek word here names men (m2), so every level says ወንዶች. The address to the whole community keeps the gender setting on 'brothers'.
